newsitem.title: UK: Clarke says UK in line to meet inflation target.
newsitem.headline: Clarke says UK in line to meet inflation target.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke, commenting on September retail price data, said Britain was absolutely in line to meet the government target of 2.5 percent underlying inflation.
"I believe we are absolutely in line to meet the inflation target," he told Reuters at the Conservative party conference.

The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said earlier that while headline inflation (RPI) was steady at 2.1 percent last month, the underlying RPIX rate -- excluding mortgage interest payments -- edged up to 2.9 percent from 2.8 percent, at which it had been stuck for four months.
